headline: New Ronald McDonald House in Atlanta Gives Hope to Families of Sick Children
meta_description: A new $90 million Ronald McDonald House near Atlanta's hospital offers 110 rooms for families of critically ill children, including specialized transplant suit…
summary_short: Families with sick children in Atlanta now have free housing steps from the hospital. The new Ronald McDonald House provides 110 rooms and 18 transplant suites.
body:
Families caring for seriously ill children in Atlanta now have a free place to rest just steps from the hospital. A new Ronald McDonald House has opened near the medical center, offering 110 rooms and 18 specialized transplant suites—a lifeline for families navigating one of life's most difficult challenges.

The $90 million facility removes one source of stress during medical crises: the cost and logistics of finding nearby lodging. When a child faces transplant surgery or intensive treatment, parents and relatives can stay close without the burden of hotel bills, allowing them to be present at their child's bedside and support one another through the ordeal.

This expansion of Ronald McDonald House services underscores a simple truth: during medical emergencies, proximity and community matter. By providing comfortable, accessible housing, the facility lets families focus entirely on what matters most—their children's recovery and healing.
quick_facts: 110 rooms available at new Atlanta Ronald McDonald House
18 specialized transplant suites for critical cases
Free housing for families of sick children
